plan.title: AD lesional vs control: GO BP over-representation
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question asks which GO biological processes are over-represented among the significant genes from the treated (lesional) vs control DESeq2 contrast in this atopic dermatitis skin dataset (6 vs 6, unpaired, single batch, 12000 genes). Because a delivered DE results table already exists, no new differential expression test is fit. We first run a sample-structure QC on the raw counts to characterize the flagged low-depth sample (sample_01, ~4x below median library size) and confirm it does not distort the group separation before we trust the delivered contrast. We then extract the significant gene list (padj < 0.05) from the delivered de_results.csv, map gene symbols to Entrez IDs, and test GO Biological Process over-representation with clusterProfiler's enricher() against the local MSigDB GOBP gene set collection (2026.1, 7,538 sets), using the full tested-gene set as the background universe rather than the genome, a 15-500 gene size window, and rrvgo semantic-similarity reduction of the resulting nested/redundant terms to representative processes. Per the flagged rule, if the significant gene list falls under ~50 genes, the ORA has little power and we run a preranked GSEA on the same GOBP collection (ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic) as the primary or supplementary answer, so the plan runs both explicitly rather than silently substituting. The final report step states the collection and its version, the universe, the size window, the ranking metric, the redundancy collapse, and the method-dependence caveat (ORA and GSEA can disagree), plus the reproducibility record (session info, package versions, gene set collection version).

steps.method: vst(blind) + PCA + sample-distance heatmap + library sizes from raw counts
GO Biological Process over-representation with clusterProfiler enricher() against MSigDB GOBP gene sets, universe = tested genes, rrvgo term reduction
fgsea preranked GSEA on DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB GOBP gene sets (secondary/robustness check)
Enrichment report with database/version, universe, size window, rank metric, redundancy collapse, method-dependence caveat
